# Signet Artists

> Signet Artists delivers music for your event in Denver, Colorado and surrounding areas. A variety of genre's and configurations are available to book - effortlessly. All sized to your event and budget, for private events across Colorado. Enjoy one contract, one point of contact for the night, and our rates published right on the website. Send us the date and the venue - we take care of  the rest.

Signet Artists is a live music company for private events in Denver, the Front Range, and the mountain corridor. Rates are published rather than quoted on request; the full card is on the pricing page.

## Credits

Trusted and booked by Amazon, NBCUniversal, Charles Schwab, Kroger, Denver Art Museum, Sheraton, Hyatt, Washington Nationals, Casa Bonita and Monarch Casino Resort Spa Black Hawk. Also Live Nation, Valley Country Club and the National Cherry Blossom Festival, and the stages at Dazzle, the Bluebird Theater, Cervantes, the 9:30 Club and many, many more.

## Acts

- Tejas Singh (Singer-songwriter covers, fronted by Tejas Singh): The only booking here that ladders. Starts as a duo and finishes as a quartet, same voice, same songs, one contract, so guests hear one band getting bigger rather than two bands swapping over. The quartet is the dance floor size. Configurations: Duo to quartet. From $2,000 in Denver. https://signetartists.com/artists/tejas-singh/
- Jazz Duo (Jazz standards, Upright bass and guitar): Standards on upright bass and guitar, played at conversation volume. Arrival, cocktails and dinner are its regular work, when the music has to hold the night without anybody having to raise their voice over it. Configurations: Duo to trio. From $2,000 in Denver. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/jazz-duo-trio/
- Dirty Flamenco (Flamenco, fronted by Gary Meyers): The only flamenco act on this roster, and close to the only one in Colorado sold as a private event product rather than a concert booking. Real palos, played by a working group with a standing repertoire. The roster's set piece. Configurations: Trio, larger by request. From $2,800 in Denver. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/flamenco-trio/
- Funk Trio (Funk and soul, Guitar, bass, drums, with voice): Funk and soul covers at trio size, for a party where the dance floor is close to the tables. The songs a crowd already knows, played by three people who can fill a floor without needing a stage to do it. Two working trios sit behind this format, which is why it holds a Saturday. Configurations: Trio. From $2,800 in Denver. https://signetartists.com/music/
- DJ (Open format, Decks, and a PA sized to the venue): Open format, on its own or carrying the late end after a band steps off. Through the same sound system, run by the same team, on the same contract. The most common single booking of the corporate season. Configurations: On its own, or with a live player. From $1,500 in Denver. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/dj/
- Blues Rock (Blues, rock and roots, One voice and a guitar, or two): Blues rock covers, solo or as a duo, at the smallest spend on this roster. Real playing rather than a playlist, at whatever volume the venue will take. Rehearsal dinners, welcome drinks, office parties, and any event where live music is the right idea and a band is the wrong size. Configurations: Solo to duo. From $900 in Denver. https://signetartists.com/music/
- Last Consulate (Instrumental downtempo, Upright bass, guitar and electronics, one player): One player, upright bass out front, over downtempo electronics with slow hip-hop drums, worn keys and delayed guitar. Jazz improvisation on top, at conversation volume. Arrival, cocktails and dinner, on original material that sounds closer to an early-2000s downtempo record than to a jazz set. Configurations: Solo. From $900 in Denver. https://signetartists.com/music/

## Rate card

Starting prices by configuration. Denver metro, then mountain and resort, which adds travel and lodging.

- Solo: Denver $900–1,200, mountain and resort $1,400–1,900.
- Duo: Denver $2,000–2,800, mountain and resort $2,800–3,800.
- Trio: Denver $2,800–3,800, mountain and resort $3,800–5,200.
- Quartet: Denver $4,000–5,500, mountain and resort $5,500–7,500.
- DJ: Denver $1,500–2,800, mountain and resort $3,000–4,800.
- Five to six piece (by request, not a standard booking): Denver $6,000–8,000, mountain and resort $8,000–11,000.

## Hourly build (Denver metro)

- Duo: $600 call-out + $450/hour. Four hours = $2,400.
- Trio: $1,000 call-out + $600/hour. Four hours = $3,400.
- Quartet: $1,600 call-out + $800/hour. Four hours = $4,800.
- DJ: $800 call-out + $350/hour. Four hours = $2,200.

Price = call-out + (hours x hourly rate). There is no overtime rate. Adding a smaller group to an existing booking bills at the hourly rate only, with no second call-out.
